title: A linear, fully decoupled, and unconditionally energy-stable SAV-FEM for the Cahn--Hilliard--Navier--Stokes model
summary: In this paper, we develop a linear, fully decoupled, and unconditionally energy-stable fully discrete finite element scheme for the Cahn--Hilliard--Navier--Stokes (CHNS) system by employing the scalar auxiliary variable (SAV) approach.
